title: SpeechRail diarization client finalize request (SPK-E2E-1, version 1)
description: Client-to-server speechrail.diarization.finalize. This is a SpeechRail extension event, not an OpenAI standard event; it must only be sent after the last input_audio_buffer.commit. finalization_id is client-chosen, 1-128 characters; retries with the same id echo the same result.
